name: Error summary
summary: A box at the top of a form that lists every problem as a link to its field, and takes focus on submit.
description:
Put data-v-validate on the form. Without JS the browser's own validation runs. With JS a submit with problems marks each invalid field, builds the summary and moves focus to it; fixing a field clears its message and its link.

A server can render the same summary itself after a failed post.

classes.name: v-error-summary
classes.description: The summary box, with a thick danger edge and a focus ring that is always drawn.

classes.name: v-error-summary-title
classes.description: The heading line: "There is a problem" or "There are n problems".

states.description: Set on the form by the JS, so the summary replaces the browser's bubbles.
Set by the JS on each invalid control, with its .v-field-error linked by aria-describedby.
The summary hides once every problem is fixed, or when a submit passes.
Lets the summary take focus from script without joining the Tab order.

hooks.name: data-v-validate
hooks.description: Turns on the error summary, field marking and focus handling. Reuses a .v-error-summary already in the form.

keyboard.action: On submit with problems: focus moves to the summary.
Moves through the links in the summary.
On a link: focuses that field, not just scrolls to it.

a11y: Focus moves to the summary on a failed submit, so screen readers read the title and the list straight away.
The summary is role="group" labelled by its title, and each link carries the same text as the field's error.
Write a .v-field-error for each field in your own words; without one the browser's validation message is used.
A failed async check (Vectra.fieldState invalid) is listed with its own message.
